column1: # The checks of shell/sign-user.nsh, the Shell boot of shell-sign-user: User Mode with
# dh lists each handle with EFI_RNG_PROTOCOL as its index, then its protocols, named Rng
# the firmware accepts the appends that KEK's key signs over each digest, and the one that the
# leaf key signs with the CA in its bundle, and uefisettings prints nothing
# db holds the enrolled certificate and the 4 appended, each in a list of its own

column3: .variable == "db-d719b2cb-3d3a-4596-a3bc-dad00e67656f" and .attributes == 39 and (.value | length) == 5 and all(.value[]; .type == "A5C059A1-94E4-4AA7-87B5-AB155C2BF072" and (.signatures | length) == 1 and .signatures[0].owner == "DE145B29-C3CD-455F-91DE-A76237B67C52") and ([.value[].signatures[0].sha256] | unique | length) == 5

column1: # it refuses the appends signed with db's key, which KEK lacks, with a key that no variable
# holds and with the leaf key without the CA that links it to KEK, and leaves db as it was
# without a clock, uefisettings refuses a write without --append or --timestamp before it
# signs, and PrivateProbe stays absent, as the next write creates it

column3: . == {"error_message": "--data-file without --append needs --timestamp here, where uefisettings reads no clock: the firmware takes only a TimeStamp later than the variable's (UEFI 2.11 section 8.2.6)"}
